_comment: Editor-side asset-catalog entries for assets that shipped definitions reference but the game exporter's asset-registry walk omitted from .assets/<Class>.json. refresh-schema.mjs merges these into the packed starter-project/.assets/<Class>.json AFTER copying the pack's catalogs, so a known-good default definition doesn't raise a spurious `missing-asset-ref` drift gate on load. Existing catalog entries always win (matched case-insensitively by `path`); overrides only fill genuine gaps. Paths must be taken verbatim from the referencing definition's own asset reference (real UE object paths); package_guid may be left empty exactly like the many real catalog entries whose guid the exporter didn't capture (the validator skips guid checks when either side is empty).
_status: EMPTY, and that is the healthy state. This file previously carried SM_ArmClub and SM_PotMace as a safety net for a stale .assets/StaticMesh.json in tsic-default-mod@beta. That catalog was regenerated upstream (1591 -> 1898 entries, tsic-default-mod a543479), which supplies both meshes as real exporter output along with 222 others, so the hand-written entries were retired rather than left to rot. Prefer fixing the pack's catalog upstream; reach for this file only when that is not possible. Note a genuinely dangling reference — an asset absent from Content entirely — must NOT be registered here: that is a data bug, and an override would only hide it. `npx tsx scripts/audit-asset-refs.ts` reports which case you have.
